title: Laash Teri Dhup Tay Rehgayi
body:
Tera Sirr Sajday Vich Rakhna, Gal Tay Khanhar Shimr Da Chalna
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Baajoun Haye Veeran,
Aaye Kaisi Shaam Aayi (x2)
Saday Khaimay Sarday Rehgaye,
Shaami Saday Burkay Lehgaye,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Turr Paiyaan Shaam Veeran,
Hathan Ch’ Rassiyan Paakay (x2)
Meri Aakay Wekh Lachaari,
Ronda Abid Laal Muhari,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aagaiyan Shaam Veeran,
Sirr Tay Nayhi Ridaawan (x2)
Sirr Tay Khaakh Di Chadaar Paayi,
Laykay Tin Barjaiyan Aayi,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Saad Waalay Daar Tay,
Ath Pehr Lang Gaye Naye (x2)
Shaami Hasday Assay Paasay,
Haye Lay Lay Naam Abbas Ay,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbaar Aagaiyan,
Main Veer Ruldi Ruldi (x2)
Jehri Babay Naal Na Bolli,
Kiwain Aj Darbaar Ich Bolli,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan Ch’ Aagaiyan,
Ummat Day Paakay Zaywaar (x2)
Tu Haar Velay Da Shahid,
Main Bachaya Keewain Abid,
Menu Veer Naye Bhulna.
